title: Customize your site readiness is a Road to live step: must-fix rules hold Publish (CUSTOMIZE_NOT_READY), worth-fixing rules warn, a published release only warns
steps: S2: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/customize-readiness.test.mjs (the severity file and summary tests run without Postgres).
expect: S1: every test passes, including must-fix, worth-fixing only, checking, published but failing and the CUSTOMIZE_NOT_READY refusal.
S2: every test that runs passes; rule-severity.json names every rule of RULES with a group, a question, a line and a reason.
S3: every test passes, including the Customize your site score title, the two groups, one prompt and Check again.
evidence: Before this change /ops could publish a template whose logo, business name or language answer is not applied; the readiness check ran only on a laptop
fence: The road and the publish door read one stored check and one severity file; a published release is never taken off
